subject: Discovery follow-up: inference reliability & commitment plan
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@solstice.io>, Tom Park <tom.park@solstice.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:20:00 -0400
Subject: Discovery follow-up: inference reliability & commitment plan

Hi Lina / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed next-step plan so we have alignment before I draft the formal MPA: 

Pain points you shared
- Intermittent p95 latency spikes during batch ingest windows (current p95 ~600ms, spikes to ~1.2s) that are hurting user engagement.
- Large variance in monthly token spend due to unpredictable traffic bursts; forecasting is hard.
- Data residency & audit log requirements for EU customers (SOC2 + audit log retention needed).

Goals you want to achieve in the next 90 days
- Stabilize p95 to <=300ms at 95% traffic load.
- Reduce per-token inference cost by ~35–45% via batching/quantization recommendations.
- Complete security checklist and evidence (SOC2 scope, retention, KMS key handling) for procurement.

What we can deliver quickly
- 2-week pilot on Redwood Dedicated to validate latency SLAs with your workload profile (we'll replicate peak windows).
- Cost projection using your sample traffic shape + suggested quantization profile (I attached an initial projection).
- Security intake: we can provide audit logs, SOC2 artifacts, and a technical contact for KMS/HSM integrations.

Proposed immediate asks from Solstice
1) Confirm primary stakeholders for pilot and security (names + emails).
2) Share a 48-hour sample of peak traffic (S3 link or DB export) so our infra team can size nodes.
3) Confirm procurement timeframe / any required PO language we should be aware of.

If the above looks right, I'll circulate a 1-page Mutual Action Plan with milestones, owners, and dates for your review by end of day tomorrow.

Attachments: Solstice_Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf (draft), inference-cost-projection.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@solstice.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Tom Park <tom.park@solstice.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: inference reliability & commitment plan

Thanks Grace — this is a helpful summary. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed primary pilot stakeholders: Lina Ortiz (Platform Lead) and Tom Park (Head of ML Ops). I'll also loop in our security engineer, Priya Ramesh (priya.ramesh@solstice.io), on the evidence requests.
- We'll provide a 48-hour sample S3 link by EOD Wednesday. ETA for that share: 2027-05-19 18:00 PDT.
- Procurement: target signing window is the first full week of June; procurement needs an initial SOW/MPA and SOC2 artifacts.

One ask: can you include a short-run cost sensitivity table in the projection showing incremental cost at 25/50/100% traffic increases? That will help our finance lead make the case.

I'll wait for your MPA draft. Happy to join a quick call on Thursday if required.

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@solstice.io>, Tom Park <tom.park@solstice.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Priya Ramesh <priya.ramesh@solstice.io>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:30:00 -0400
Subject: Mutual Action Plan (MPA) v1 — milestones, owners, and dates

Lina / Tom / Priya —

Per our exchange, attached is MPA v1 (one page) plus a short cost-sensitivity sheet. Summary of milestones below — please review and flag any changes to owners or dates: 

MPA v1 (high level)
1) Pilot kickoff — Redwood Dedicated environment provisioned + baseline tests
   - Owner (Redwood): Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai)
   - Owner (Solstice): Tom Park (tom.park@solstice.io)
   - Target: 2027-05-24 kickoff; 2027-06-07 pilot completion (2 weeks)

2) Security & compliance intake (evidence handoff)
   - Owner (Redwood): Soojin Lee (soojin_lee@redwood.ai)
   - Owner (Solstice): Priya Ramesh (priya.ramesh@solstice.io)
   - Target: initial evidence provided by 2027-05-26; follow-ups by 2027-06-03

3) Cost validation & model tuning
   - Owner (Redwood): Grace O'Connor (grace_oconnor@redwood.ai)
   - Owner (Solstice): Lina Ortiz (lina.ortiz@solstice.io)
   - Target: cost sensitivity update and quantization recommendation by 2027-05-28

4) Procurement & SOW sign-off
   - Owner (Redwood): Legal Ops (wf: redwood-contracts@redwood.ai) / Ben Carter (commercial lead)
   - Owner (Solstice): Procurement (TBD — please share contact)
   - Target: SOW/MPA agreed by 2027-06-07; signature week: 2027-06-07 to 2027-06-14

Success criteria for move to production
- p95 <= 300ms on replicated peak windows for 7 consecutive days during pilot
- Cost per 1M tokens <= target in projection (within 10% of modeled savings)
- SOC2 evidence + audit log retention confirmed for EU workloads

Immediate asks (action items)
- Solstice: provide 48-hour sample dataset for sizing (S3 link) by 2027-05-19 EOD PDT.
- Solstice: confirm procurement contact and any PO language by 2027-05-24.
- Redwood: circulate final MPA and pilot runbook by 2027-05-20.

Attachments: Solstice_Redwood_MPA_v1.pdf (1-page MPA), inference-cost-projection.xlsx (sensitivity tables)

If everyone is aligned I'll convert this into a signed MPA and add dates to a shared Drive doc (link below).

Thanks — I'll also set a 30-minute pilot kickoff slot for next week once we get the sample.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Tom Park <tom.park@solstice.io>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@solstice.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Priya Ramesh <priya.ramesh@solstice.io>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 02:00:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (MPA) v1 — milestones, owners, and dates

Thanks Grace — this looks good and comprehensive. Two quick additions from procurement/ops side: 
- Procurement wants a 14-day pilot/PO-free evaluation followed by a short pilot acceptance form sign-off; can you confirm Redwood is comfortable with a 14-day no-PO pilot?
- Please add a procurement checkpoint to the MPA: document review by our legal (estimated 3 business days) after pilot success.

We can confirm procurement contact tomorrow; Lina will send Priya's S3 link today.
